verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a hosted inference service, which holds account data, usage records, and uploaded fine-tuned models. The pack documents no export capability. OpenAI API compatibility eases switching providers, and Prometheus metrics expose operational telemetry, but neither is an export of the user's data in open formats. The S3 model upload is import-only, not export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
